This notebook reproduces the plasma-protein analyses of the manuscript
(main Figure 5, Supplementary Figure 5, Supplementary Table 6).

**Design.** GLUL, ALDH2, ECHS1 and SCP2 were pre-specified upstream of this
analysis (differential abundance, spatial transcriptomics and tissue validation;
see manuscript). Because that selection used the discovery cohort, the
discovery cohort is used here **only** to derive one classification cut-off per
protein (Youden's index), which is then locked. **All performance estimates are
computed in the independent validation cohort.** No multivariable model is
fitted.

**Contrasts.**

* Primary: HG-IPMN + PDAC vs LG-IPMN (`malignant_PDAC`)
* Secondary (exploratory, 9 events in validation): HG-IPMN vs LG-IPMN, PDAC excluded (`malignant_IPMN`)

**CA19-9** is available only as a binary clinical call (positive/negative at
each centre's routine threshold), so it is never compared against a protein ROC
curve; it is compared as a binary call against each protein's locked binary
call, and combined with GLUL in an exploratory "either-positive" rule.

Run from the repository root (knitting this file does that automatically).
All outputs are written to `output/`.

```{r setup, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE}
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(pROC)
library(cutpointr)
library(cvms)
library(writexl)

PATH    <- "Data/Cohorts.xlsx"
MARKERS <- c("GLUL", "ALDH2", "ECHS1", "SCP2")
BOOT_N  <- 2000
SEED    <- 42

dir.create("output", showWarnings = FALSE)
```

# Data

```{r load}
load_cohort <- function(path, cohort) {
  as.data.frame(read_xlsx(path, sheet = cohort)) %>%
    mutate(
      # Primary contrast: HG-IPMN or PDAC = 1, LG-IPMN = 0
      malignant_PDAC = as.integer(Type %in% c("High-Grade IPMN", "PDAC")),
      # Secondary contrast: HG-IPMN = 1, LG-IPMN = 0, PDAC excluded (NA)
      malignant_IPMN = case_when(
        Type == "High-Grade IPMN" ~ 1L,
        Type == "Low-Grade IPMN"  ~ 0L,
        TRUE                      ~ NA_integer_
      ),
      # CA19-9 binary call; "miss" = not recorded (NA, never treated as negative)
      ca19_pos = case_when(
        trimws(Ca19) == "pos" ~ 1L,
        trimws(Ca19) == "neg" ~ 0L,
        TRUE                  ~ NA_integer_
      )
    )
}

df_disc <- load_cohort(PATH, "Discovery")
df_val  <- load_cohort(PATH, "Validation")

table(Discovery  = df_disc$Type)
table(Validation = df_val$Type)
```

# 1. Discrimination in the validation cohort (AUROC)

AUROC with 95% CI from 2,000 stratified bootstrap replicates.

```{r roc-functions}
roc_ci_plot <- function(data, marker, outcome,
                        fill = "cadetblue", boot_n = BOOT_N, seed = SEED) {
  set.seed(seed)
  r <- pROC::roc(data[[outcome]], data[[marker]], percent = TRUE, quiet = TRUE,
           direction = "<", levels = c(0, 1))
  ci_se <- pROC::ci.se(r, specificities = seq(0, 100, 1), boot.n = boot_n,
                 method = "bootstrap", progress = "none")
  band  <- data.frame(specificity = seq(0, 100, 1), lo = ci_se[, 1], hi = ci_se[, 3])

  curve <- data.frame(specificity = r$specificities, sensitivity = r$sensitivities)
  curve <- curve[order(curve$specificity, curve$sensitivity), ]

  set.seed(seed)
  auc_ci  <- pROC::ci.auc(r, method = "bootstrap", boot.n = boot_n, stratified = TRUE,
                    progress = "none")
  auc_lab <- sprintf("AUC = %.1f%% (%.1f-%.1f)", as.numeric(pROC::auc(r)), auc_ci[1], auc_ci[3])

  ggplot() +
    geom_ribbon(data = band, aes(specificity, ymin = lo, ymax = hi),
                fill = fill, color = "black", alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_step(data = curve, aes(specificity, sensitivity), direction = "vh", linewidth = 0.9) +
    geom_segment(aes(x = 100, y = 0, xend = 0, yend = 100), linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey60") +
    annotate("text", x = 50, y = 5, label = auc_lab, hjust = 0.5) +
    scale_x_reverse(limits = c(100, 0), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    coord_equal() +
    labs(title = marker, x = "Specificity (%)", y = "Sensitivity (%)") +
    theme_classic(base_size = 10) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5))
}

auroc_table <- function(data, outcome, boot_n = BOOT_N, seed = SEED) {
  do.call(rbind, lapply(MARKERS, function(m) {
    r <- pROC::roc(data[[outcome]], data[[m]], quiet = TRUE, direction = "<", levels = c(0, 1))
    set.seed(seed)
    cb <- as.numeric(pROC::ci.auc(r, method = "bootstrap", boot.n = boot_n, stratified = TRUE,
                            progress = "none"))
    data.frame(marker = m,
               AUC = round(as.numeric(pROC::auc(r)), 3),
               lo  = round(cb[1], 3),
               hi  = round(cb[3], 3))
  }))
}
```

# 2. Discovery-derived cut-offs — Supplementary Table 6

One cut-off per protein and contrast, maximising Youden's index in the
discovery cohort (rule: marker >= cut-off -> positive). Where a protein
separates the discovery classes completely (GLUL), every value inside the gap
maximises Youden's index; the midpoint of the gap is used.

```{r cutoffs}
find_cutoffs <- function(data, marker, outcome) {
  x <- data[[marker]]; y <- data[[outcome]]
  keep <- !is.na(x) & !is.na(y)
  x <- x[keep]; y <- y[keep]

  cp_y <- cutpointr(x = x, class = y,
                    method = maximize_metric, metric = youden,
                    direction = ">=", pos_class = 1, neg_class = 0,
                    na.rm = TRUE, silent = TRUE)

  complete_sep <- isTRUE(cp_y$acc == 1)
  cutoff <- if (complete_sep) {
    # midpoint between the highest negative and the lowest positive value
    (max(x[y == 0]) + min(x[y == 1])) / 2
  } else {
    cp_y$optimal_cutpoint
  }

  data.frame(marker      = marker,
             youden_cut  = cutoff,
             youden_sens = round(cp_y$sensitivity, 3),
             youden_spec = round(cp_y$specificity, 3),
             complete_separation = complete_sep)
}

cutoffs_PDAC <- do.call(rbind, lapply(MARKERS, find_cutoffs, data = df_disc, outcome = "malignant_PDAC"))
cutoffs_IPMN <- do.call(rbind, lapply(MARKERS, find_cutoffs, data = df_disc, outcome = "malignant_IPMN"))
cutoffs_PDAC
cutoffs_IPMN

write_xlsx(cutoffs_PDAC, "output/cutoffs_PDAC.xlsx")
write_xlsx(cutoffs_IPMN, "output/cutoffs_IPMN.xlsx")
```

# 3. Locked cut-offs applied to the validation cohort

Sensitivity, specificity, PPV, NPV and accuracy with exact (Clopper–Pearson)
95% CIs; balanced accuracy with a 2,000-replicate bootstrap CI.

```{r metric-functions}
ci_binom <- function(x, n) {
  b <- binom.test(x, n)
  c(est = x / n, lo = b$conf.int[1], hi = b$conf.int[2])
}

bal_acc <- function(truth, pred) {
  mean(c(sum(pred == 1 & truth == 1) / sum(truth == 1),
         sum(pred == 0 & truth == 0) / sum(truth == 0)))
}

# Full metric set for one binary prediction against the truth
metrics_from_pred <- function(truth, pred, label, boot_n = BOOT_N, seed = SEED) {
  tp <- sum(pred == 1 & truth == 1); fn <- sum(pred == 0 & truth == 1)
  tn <- sum(pred == 0 & truth == 0); fp <- sum(pred == 1 & truth == 0)
  n  <- tp + fn + tn + fp

  set.seed(seed)
  bs <- replicate(boot_n, { i <- sample(n, replace = TRUE); bal_acc(truth[i], pred[i]) })
  ba <- c(est = bal_acc(truth, pred),
          lo  = unname(quantile(bs, 0.025, na.rm = TRUE)),
          hi  = unname(quantile(bs, 0.975, na.rm = TRUE)))

  m <- rbind(Accuracy    = ci_binom(tp + tn, n),
             Sensitivity = ci_binom(tp, tp + fn),
             Specificity = ci_binom(tn, tn + fp),
             PPV         = ci_binom(tp, tp + fp),
             NPV         = ci_binom(tn, tn + fn),
             `Balanced accuracy` = ba)
  data.frame(predictor = label, metric = rownames(m), m,
             TP = tp, FN = fn, TN = tn, FP = fp, row.names = NULL)
}

marker_metrics <- function(marker, data, cutoffs, outcome) {
  cut  <- cutoffs$youden_cut[cutoffs$marker == marker]
  data <- data[!is.na(data[[outcome]]), ]          # secondary contrast: drops PDAC
  metrics_from_pred(data[[outcome]], as.integer(data[[marker]] >= cut), marker)
}

METRIC_ORDER <- c("Sensitivity", "Specificity", "PPV", "NPV", "Accuracy", "Balanced accuracy")

plot_metrics <- function(df, fill) {
  df$metric    <- factor(df$metric, levels = rev(METRIC_ORDER))
  df$predictor <- factor(df$predictor, levels = unique(df$predictor))
  ggplot(df, aes(est, metric)) +
    geom_pointrange(aes(xmin = lo, xmax = hi), shape = 21, fill = fill,
                    color = "black", linewidth = 0.7) +
    geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f (%.2f-%.2f)", est, lo, hi)), vjust = -0.8, size = 2.6) +
    coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 1.25), breaks = seq(0, 1, 0.25), labels = scales::percent) +
    facet_wrap(~ predictor, ncol = 4) +
    labs(x = "Estimate (95% CI)", y = NULL) +
    theme_classic(base_size = 11) +
    theme(strip.background = element_blank(), strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
          axis.line.x = element_blank(), axis.line.y = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.y = element_blank())
}

plot_cm <- function(truth, pred, lab, fill, ylab) {
  t <- factor(truth, levels = c(0, 1), labels = lab)   # fixed levels keep a 2x2
  p <- factor(pred,  levels = c(0, 1), labels = lab)   # even if one class is never predicted
  plot_confusion_matrix(confusion_matrix(targets = t, predictions = p),
                        add_normalized = TRUE,
                        add_col_percentages = FALSE, add_row_percentages = FALSE,
                        tile_border_color = "black", add_arrows = FALSE,
                        add_zero_shading = FALSE,
                        palette = list(low = "#EAEAEA", high = fill)) +
    labs(x = "Actual", y = ylab)
}

plot_cm_marker <- function(marker, cutoffs, data, outcome, lab, fill) {
  cut  <- cutoffs$youden_cut[cutoffs$marker == marker]
  data <- data[!is.na(data[[outcome]]), ]
  plot_cm(data[[outcome]], as.integer(data[[marker]] >= cut), lab, fill,
          paste0(marker, " - Cut-off"))
}
```

Sensitivity of GLUL within the malignant class, by histology (shows how much
of the primary endpoint is carried by PDAC):

```{r glul-by-histology}
glul_cut_PDAC <- cutoffs_PDAC$youden_cut[cutoffs_PDAC$marker == "GLUL"]
df_val %>%
  filter(malignant_PDAC == 1) %>%
  group_by(Type) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), detected = sum(GLUL >= glul_cut_PDAC),
            sensitivity = detected / n,
            lo = binom.test(detected, n)$conf.int[1],
            hi = binom.test(detected, n)$conf.int[2])
```

# 4. CA19-9 — binary comparison and complementarity

Restricted to validation patients with CA19-9 recorded (complete cases).
GLUL is evaluated at its locked discovery cut-off; the "either-positive" rule
calls a patient positive if GLUL or CA19-9 is positive. This is a
complementarity analysis at fixed operating points, not a comparison of
discrimination.

```{r ca19-cc}
df_val_cc <- subset(df_val, !is.na(ca19_pos))
table(df_val_cc$Type)

ca19_rule <- function(data, cutoffs, outcome, marker = "GLUL") {
  cut   <- cutoffs$youden_cut[cutoffs$marker == marker]
  cc    <- !is.na(data$ca19_pos) & !is.na(data[[outcome]])
  truth <- data[[outcome]][cc]
  mk    <- as.integer(data[[marker]][cc] >= cut)
  ca19  <- data$ca19_pos[cc]
  either <- as.integer(mk == 1 | ca19 == 1)

  neg_mal <- ca19 == 0 & truth == 1
  cat(sprintf("Complete cases: %d | %s-positive among CA19-9-negative malignant: %d of %d\n",
              sum(cc), marker, sum(mk[neg_mal] == 1), sum(neg_mal)))

  list(truth = truth, ca19 = ca19, marker = mk, either = either,
       metrics = rbind(metrics_from_pred(truth, ca19,   "CA19-9"),
                       metrics_from_pred(truth, mk,     marker),
                       metrics_from_pred(truth, either, paste0("Ca19-9 + ", marker))))
}
```

```{r ca19-primary, fig.width = 7.5, fig.height = 2.5}

```
